Public helper that atomically decreases the caller's allowance for a spender.
Internal core transfer logic that validates addresses and updates _balances.

Internal burn logic that decreases _totalSupply and debits _balances[account].

Internal function that burns tokens from an account and reduces the caller's allowance.

edges.reason: transfer() delegates to internal _transfer using msg.sender, recipient and amount.
transferFrom() delegates to internal _transfer with sender, recipient and amount.
transferFrom() recomputes the allowance through _approve using SafeMath.sub(amount); the subtraction is overflow/underflow safe.
approve() delegates to internal _approve with msg.sender as owner.
increaseAllowance() delegates to _approve after SafeMath.add(addedValue).
decreaseAllowance() delegates to _approve after SafeMath.sub(subtractedValue).
_transfer() debits _balances[sender] and credits _balances[recipient].
_mint() increases _totalSupply by amount.
_mint() credits _balances[account] by amount.
_burn() decreases _totalSupply by value.
_burn() debits _balances[account] by value.
_approve() writes _allowances[owner][spender] = value.
_burnFrom() calls _burn(account, amount).
_burnFrom() reduces the caller's allowance through _approve.
constructor mints the entire supply via _mint(tokenOwnerAddress, totalSupply).
constructor executes the external value transfer feeReceiver.transfer(msg.value).

External call to feeReceiver can run recipient code before the constructor returns, but Solidity transfer() forwards only a 2300 gas stipend so state-changing reentrancy is not practically exploitable.
constructor assigns the name parameter into _name.
constructor assigns the symbol parameter into _symbol.
constructor assigns the decimals parameter into _decimals.
burn() delegates to internal _burn(msg.sender, value).
name() reads _name.
symbol() reads _symbol.
decimals() reads _decimals.
msg.sender is supplied as the sender argument to _transfer from transfer() and transferFrom().
msg.sender is used as owner/spender when approve, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance and _burnFrom call _approve.
burn() passes msg.sender as the account to _burn, so a caller can only destroy their own balance.
_burnFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is reduced.
recipient parameter flows into transfer() as the destination of the token movement.
amount parameter flows into transfer() and is forwarded to _transfer.
sender parameter flows into transferFrom() and is forwarded to _transfer.
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom() as the destination address.
amount parameter flows into transferFrom() and is subtracted from the caller's allowance.
spender parameter flows into approve() and becomes the allowance spender.
value parameter flows into approve() and becomes the new allowance.
spender parameter flows into increaseAllowance().
addedValue parameter flows into increaseAllowance() and is added with SafeMath.add.
spender parameter flows into decreaseAllowance().
subtractedValue parameter flows into decreaseAllowance() and is subtracted with SafeMath.sub.
sender parameter is validated and debited inside _transfer.
recipient parameter is validated and credited inside _transfer.
amount parameter is added/subtracted on _balances inside _transfer.
account parameter receives the minted balance and supply credit in _mint.
amount parameter is added to _totalSupply and _balances in _mint.
account parameter is debited inside _burn.
value parameter is subtracted from _totalSupply and _balances in _burn.
owner parameter indexes the _allowances mapping written by _approve.
spender parameter indexes the _allowances mapping written by _approve.
value parameter is the allowance value stored by _approve.
account parameter is the target of both _burn and the allowance reduction in _burnFrom.
amount parameter is burned and deducted from the spender allowance in _burnFrom.
name constructor argument is written to _name state variable.
symbol constructor argument is written to _symbol state variable.
decimals constructor argument is written to _decimals state variable.
totalSupply constructor argument is used as the mint amount.
totalSupply constructor argument flows into _mint as the amount minted.
feeReceiver constructor argument is the recipient of msg.value.
feeReceiver is the call target of the external value transfer feeReceiver.transfer(msg.value).
tokenOwnerAddress constructor argument receives 100% of the minted supply.
tokenOwnerAddress flows into _mint as the account credited with the whole supply.
value parameter flows into burn() and is forwarded to _burn.
